record.original_question: For a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i, interpret the dual cone C_i^∨ in homogeneous truncated moment terms. Concretely, determine what kind of homogeneous truncated moment sequences or representing measures correspond to membership in C_i^∨, in analogy with the identification of P_{n+1,2d}^∨ as the cone of homogeneous truncated moment sequences that admit representing measures supported on the unit sphere S^n.

evidence.quote: Thus, the dual cone P∨ n+1,2d can be interpreted as the cone of homogeneous truncated moment sequences that admit representing measures supported on Sn.
Open Problem 3. Interpret C∨ i in the setting of the homogeneous truncated moment problem.

artifact.category_tag: positive semidefinite forms and moment problems
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let n,d be positive integers and let R[x_0,...,x_n]_{2d} denote the real vector space of homogeneous polynomials of degree 2d in n+1 variables. Let Σ_{n+1,2d} ⊆ R[x_0,...,x_n]_{2d} be the cone of sums of squares of forms of degree d, and let P_{n+1,2d} be the cone of positive semidefinite forms of degree 2d. Consider a filtration of closed convex cones

    Σ_{n+1,2d} = C_0 ⊆ C_1 ⊆ ... ⊆ C_N = P_{n+1,2d},

obtained via the Gram matrix construction: to each projective variety V ⊆ P^{k-1} containing the image of the Veronese embedding ν_d : P^n → P^{k-1} (where k = dim R[x_0,...,x_n]_d), one associates the cone

    C(V) = { f ∈ R[x_0,...,x_n]_{2d} : f admits a positive semidefinite Gram matrix Q whose associated quadratic form vanishes on V } ,

and the C_i are the (finitely many) distinct cones obtained as V ranges over such varieties. Call C_i strictly separating if C_{i-1} ⊊ C_i ⊊ C_{i+1}. With respect to the standard apolar (Bombieri) inner product on R[x_0,...,x_n]_{2d}, the dual cone of P_{n+1,2d} can be identified with the cone of homogeneous truncated moment sequences L : R[x_0,...,x_n]_{2d} → R that admit a representing measure supported on the unit sphere S^n ⊆ R^{n+1}, i.e. L(f) = ∫_{S^n} f dμ for some positive Borel measure μ.

Problem. For a strictly separating intermediate cone C_i in the filtration above, give an analogous intrinsic characterization of its dual cone C_i^∨ as a set of homogeneous truncated moment sequences. Specifically, identify the class of representing measures (their supports, or other defining structural conditions) whose moment sequences are exactly the elements of C_i^∨.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is explicitly posed as an open problem in the source work, and a web search yields no follow-up work resolving it.

status_evidence.title: arXiv:2411.06468
status_evidence.snippet: The paper presents open problems concerning the dual cones of intermediate cones C_i between Σ_{n+1,2d} and P_{n+1,2d}.
status_evidence.claim: Interpreting C_i^∨ in homogeneous truncated moment terms is stated as an open problem.
